text_en: We're finally back on board... Those pirates have a high price to pay.
A flying iron castle! How is that possible?
We don't have time to explain the history of our evolution to you, so please try to concentrate on the mission.
Of course...

Now, listen closely. The pirates have disabled almost all of the module's systems but, thanks to that orb, you'll be able to clear a path for yourself by recharging different circuits. However, even with the orb, there will still be disabled doors that you'll only be able to open with positively charged vimana minerals. You'll need to find the four generators.
Try starting with the entrance door. After that, I'll provide you with the minerals.
Gentlemen, have you finished? While you were talking, I had an idea. I could scout ahead with Irka and try to find the best routes to reach those generators.
You would have to be able to fly to allow us access. Nearly all the conduits are closed off right now.
You don't know how happy it makes me that you've said that, he, he, he...
Get ready to be amazed. I've been keeping this trick up my sleeve for just this type of situation.
I've never been one for magic, but Irka was blessed with this power when we arrived here.
Absolutely speechless, aren't you? I imagined as much...
Ah, your dog has wings...
Your horse has wings. Proceed with your reconnaissance mission. Inform us if you find something.
I was hoping for a bigger reaction, to be honest...
Alright, I shan't hang around any longer. I'm off.
Stay alert, I'll be back to let you know what I've found.
We are inside. That gate is code-operated. Just a moment...
Well done! We have restored basic systems in this area. Use the transporter to proceed on your path.
Here are the positively charged vimana minerals. Remember, you must place them in the four generators in order to gain access to the main control room.
We are counting on you. Strength, human!
Make way for the great Euder!
Hello again, my little friend.
Have you seen just how amazing this machine is? And they say they don't use magic! I wonder how they keep it floating...
Ah, I almost forgot amongst all the excitement. I've located the generators. Unfortunately, without that toy of yours, no one can access them. Give me your map, I'll mark their whereabouts for you.
You'll thank me when we're back on terra firma.
Since we're up in the air, I'm going to take the opportunity to have a look good at the area. I'm sure General Brigard will find it useful to have an idea of what surrounds us in this world.
Be good and, above all, be careful. It looks like this air pirate thing is no joke. There's a flying boat that's keeping them anchored.
We're off! Giddy up, Irka!
Magnificent and shining refined crystal... It's taken three days but, finally, you have the right energy grade.
With you, we'll conquer the skies, just as it always should have been.

Steel armour...
Ragged garments...
Swords, staffs and arrows...
You Humans are primitive to the point of boredom.
I don't understand how these Croma have managed to ally with something to uninteresting. They must be desperate.
I'm sorry to tell you that, while you've managed to get this far, there is nothing you can do. We have full control of the module.
Although...
Did you think I wouldn't notice that you had this on you? Its shine is hypnotising, isn't it?
I'll take this. Just in case, you know?
If I were you, I'd go. It's not a good idea to stay somewhere like this. Who knows how long it'll be before it comes crashing down?
Listen to me and go back to your village, Human. Otherwise, things will end badly for you.
You've been warned.
Str... th... Hum...
Human, can you hear me? Is this working?
I'm speaking to you through the communicator.
It looks like you've just meet the pirates' leader.
But, without those vimana minerals, you won't be able to reactivate the different sectors within the module. Blast... those were all we had to hand.
Wait, tell me you've kept the <color=OBJ>negatively polarised minerals</color>. Yes, the red ones you found in the generators.
Good! You Humans are more astute than the commander expected.
I can restore their original polarity in the testing room so that they start to generate energy again.
I'm going there now. If you carry on, you'll be able to find it.
I'll wait for you there. Over and out.
I see you managed to arrive without issues, though I'm not particularly surprised at this point.
We must hurry. Give me the minerals and I'll restore them, though I should tell you that the process will take some time. Best be patient.
How does this work...?
Don't worry, I've seen the process a thousand times. I'll manage, I just need to focus.
Well..._100_ done._100_ What a splendid catch.
I think I'll share this feast with you._100_ Would you..._100_ like that?
Was it you..._300_ or me...?
Phew, I've done it! I knew I could, you had nothing to fear!
Hmmm?_100_ Are you alright?_100_ You look exhausted.
You've been practicing so you can kill that rat, haven't you?
You should save your energy, I don't think it'll be easy to carry on from this point.
Keep them safe, I don't know where we'll get more if you lose them.
Strength, Human.
Who...? Who are you...?
Are you here to finish us off now that we're weakened?
It's alright, he's not one of those pirates. He's with me. He's called Human.
Commander...
I know what you're thinking. I know they don't look much, but they've proven themselves to be a fierce ally, believe me.
That's not what I was going to say, Commander. I'm sorry that they were able to take over the Module so easily.
It must have been hard resorting to help from such a primitive race.
No need to apologise. The spineless attack carried on us by those vermin took us all by complete surprise.

You've arrived just in time. We've retreated to this point to launch a surprise counterattack, but those birds are sharp-witted. They surrounded us and blocked off the air ducts. We thought we wouldn't survive to tell the tale.
You know the circumstances our species find itself in. It is imperative that we survive at all costs.
The one who appears to be their leader is on the rear deck. I don't know what he's been doing, but he seems to be plotting something.
We will not let him escape, but I need you all to get to safety first.
So, you're still here...
Didn't I tell you it was dangerous to stay on this piece of junk?
The party's over. We've already taken everything of value to us, so I don't plan on staying another minute on this trash heap.
Although... you've already taken a fair few blows, perhaps I could try out my new energy source on you.
Don't take it personally, Human.
UNLIMITED POWER!
Our potential will be infinite from now on!
Don't be afraid, I'll be quick.
How can this be?
How can someone like you defeat the Pirates of the Broken Wing?
Today was supposed to be the start of our great destiny...
Grrr... Your people have earnt a place on our list of enemies. One day we'll pillage and plunder you, just for fun. Enjoy your victory, bumpkin.
Have no fear, for the cavalry is here!
Never better said, right?
What has happened? Where is that vermin?
I see, he has fled with his tail between his legs. He is lucky that our priority now is to repair our systems.
In the name of the Croma survivors of Floating Module Gamma, we are eternally indebted to the soldiers of Zarga. From now on, your hunt shall be our hunt.
As agreed, you may keep the ray orb.
You may keep the electric orb.
Gentlemen, gentlemen...
No need to thank us. Zarga always takes on danger in the name of justice... though celebration is most welcome.
You have done a lot for us. You may use any of our transporters to leave the ship at any time, and you're free to return whenever you like.
Thanks for the invitation, but we have a Guardian to find.
Guardian?
Didn't those Valkyries task you with the same mission?
As I said, we came to this world on our Floating Module. There is much about it that we simply do not know.
So it seems all of us are the weird ones around here, then.
Never mind.
Soldier, we should head back. While I was flying above this machine, I noticed an interesting area beyond the swamp to the east.
I'd like to explore it and deliver a full report of our adventures to General Brigard.
Whad'ya say? Shall we go for one last ride? Promise to get you home in time for dinner!
Yes! I know I could count on you.
Alright, let Irka work his magic.
Now, hop on!
Humans, one last thing...
The beings you defeated in the city are what brought us here. Be extremely careful; they're more dangerous than you could ever imagine. There are sure to be more out there.
Of course. We're off; let us know if those pretentious pigeons try to mess with you again. We'd be happy to beat them back again.
Strength, Human.
Giddy up!
I can't see much further ahead thanks to the gases in this area. I'm willing to bet there's something around here of use to our search.
We're about to arrive.
Str... th... Hum...
Pay attention, Human. What you see before you is one of the four generators we need to restart in order to access the control room.
In order to insert the <color=OBJ>positively polarised mineral</color> into the generator, we first need to supply it with energy.
Try to restore power to it by using the <color=OBJ>Electric Orb</color>.
Strength, Human. Over and out.
